lesson_title: Where in the World Do You Live?
hook_text: Your address is not just a street. It is a farm, a village, a town or a city.
clip_script: First day of Grade 4 in Mthatha. Social Sciences is two subjects in one. Geography is about places, people and the land. History is about the past. Grade 4 is a new phase: more subjects, more reading, your own notebook, and tests and projects that count. And the first Geography topic? Places where people live. A place where people live together is called a settlement. A farm, a village, a town, a city. Which one is yours?
visual_style: Whiteboard book split into two halves, a globe on one side and a clock on the other, then four little drawings: farm, village, town, city.
mood: Bright and curious, like the first day of something new.
pacing: Quick split of the two subjects, one line on the new phase, then the four kinds of settlement popping up.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and work out what kind of settlement you live in.
